lessons_used: Evidence for all tested change kinds (adoption/redesign, choose_path/copy, choose_path/layout, finish/notification, sign_in/hint, and sign_in/reorder) is still thin as each has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all Round 1 tests and most Round 2 tests.
Predictions were too low for sign_in/hint, where measured results (+11.5%) significantly exceeded the predicted gain (+3.0%).

candidates.title: Spotlight Redesign for Companion Selection
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice screen into a spotlight stage layout where active pet animations highlight companion traits.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 65.9% with high mean wait times; support emails report user confusion and visual setup failures during pet generation.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet choice screen while preserving its required function.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 34.1% with high wait time; both funnel and support emails highlight issues. Past redesign test showed moderate lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Screen Anchor Position Setup Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated anchor configuration screen allowing users to pick which corner or taskbar position their pet should inhabit.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails mention pets failing to appear on the desktop or remaining hidden behind active application windows.

new_desktop_anchor.headline: Select Desktop Anchor Location
new_desktop_anchor.body: Choose which corner of your monitor your pet will stay anchored to.

guard.reason: Adds a valid anchor setup screen to the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Support emails mention hidden pets, but adding a new screen can increase drop-off during onboarding.

candidates.title: Companion Temperament and Activity Profile Flow
candidates.change: Add a companion personality customization screen between pet selection and certificate issuance to configure desktop activity level.
candidates.why: Support emails report users feeling confused about how pets behave post-onboarding, while adoption conversion shows a steep drop-off.

new_temperament_setting.headline: Set Companion Energy & Behavior
new_temperament_setting.body: Select whether your pet is energetic, relaxed, or quiet while you work.

guard.reason: screen 'new_temperament_setting' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Creation
candidates.change: Shift the sign-in step to take place immediately after completing the adoption certificate instead of before pet picking.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 23.4% of users early; deferring account creation until after pet creation builds user investment.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step to after adoption certificate as explicitly permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step drops 23.4%, but previous sign_in/reorder test resulted in a -5.9% relative loss.

candidates.title: Account Persistence and Quick Restore Hint
candidates.change: Add clear guidance text explaining how cloud account sign-in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in under different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Use your primary account to keep existing desktop pets and restore previous progress.

guard.reason: Adds clear account guidance hint to sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign_in drops; sign_in/hint previously achieved +7.0% lift with low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Multi-Phase Initialization Status Checklist
candidates.change: Display explicit status steps on the waiting screen indicating desktop window initialization progress.
candidates.why: Home initialization median wait is 201s with a high mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about whether the app has stalled.

waiting.headline: Preparing Companion Engine
waiting.body: 1. Building pet animations... 2. Initializing desktop window overlay... 3. Spawning pet.

guard.reason: Updates waiting screen with explicit progress information.

candidates.score_note: High mean wait time (2336s) at home step causes uncertainty; progress checklist clarifies state.

candidates.title: System Tray Alert When Companion Is Ready
candidates.change: Provide an option to send a native operating system notification when companion initialization completes.
candidates.why: Users experience prolonged wait times in the home step (mean 2336s), causing them to switch windows and miss readiness.

waiting.hint: We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds notification option on the waiting screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s mean), though OS notification integration requires native changes.

candidates.title: Direct Path Option Headline and Body Copy
candidates.change: Reframe choose_path messaging with clear action verbs contrasting instant desktop spawn against custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose_path mean completion time is 514s despite 8s median, indicating decision hesitation for a segment of users.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Meet Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick an instant starter buddy or build a fully custom desktop companion.

guard.reason: Updates path selection copy while maintaining both path options.

candidates.score_note: Easy copy change, but choose_path/copy previously yielded -1.0% drop and support evidence is weak.

candidates.title: Starter Desktop Accessory Choice Incentive
candidates.change: Offer users a free cosmetic accessory selection prompt on the final onboarding screen before entering desktop mode.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2%; providing an immediate reward incentivizes completion of the setup flow.

home_intro.headline: Setup Complete! Pick a Welcome Gift
home_intro.body: Choose a free hat or accessory for your companion to wear right now.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'free' and 'gift', violating rule 3.

candidates.title: Two-Column Layout for Pet Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Convert adoption_certificate to a two-column split layout displaying the visual certificate alongside official confirmation details.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 65.9%; upgrading certificate visual appeal strengthens emotional attachment before desktop spawn.

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption certificate layout while retaining official adoption confirmation.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop rate (34.1%), but layout changes previously performed poorly (-3.5% in choose_path/layout).

picked: Account Persistence and Quick Restore Hint
Direct Path Option Headline and Body Copy

decisions.title: Account Persistence and Quick Restore Hint
Direct Path Option Headline and Body Copy

decisions.outcome: lost: did not hold up in re-test

shipped: Account Persistence and Quick Restore Hint
lessons_next: sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+5.8% after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/redesign, choose_path/layout, finish/notification, home/new_screen, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all Round 1 tests and for major redesigns.
Predictions were too low for the first sign_in/hint test, where measured results (+11.5%) significantly exceeded the predicted gain (+3.0%).
